page.overview:
Who is Colossal Invincible Piranha Plant?

The Colossal Invincible Piranha Plant is an alternate form of the Piranha Plant from Super Mario-kun.

After Mario performed the "SNES Controller Nunchuck" against the Piranha Plants. A Piranha Plant transformed into the Colossal Invincible Piranha Plant. After it performed the "Iron Root Kick" onto Mario, it opened its mouth to eat the trio. Mario spot its weak point through the uvala. Mario and Yoshi's "Mario & Yoshi's Rolling Attack" puzzled the Colossal Invincible Piranha Plant and broke his head. Colossal Invincible Piranha Plant fell in defeat.
